name: Urban Legends Online
rate_limit_info: Standard web rate-limiting; no bulk harvesting or scraping permitted.
supported_research_purpose: Discovery of contemporary urban legends, ghost stories, rumors, and motif identification.
licensing_info: All rights reserved on modern editorial narrative text; traditional folk motifs are public domain.
known_limitations: No public API or structured feed; proprietary retellings; full-text ingestion strictly prohibited without express permission.

name: Folklore-ai GitHub Repository
rate_limit_info: Standard GitHub web and API rate limits apply.
supported_research_purpose: Conceptual reference for AI-assisted folklore generation grounded in Indian mythological narrative themes.
licensing_info: Subject to repository license inspection; code and prompt design reference only.
known_limitations: Contains application code and prompts, not an authenticated historical folklore corpus; synthetic outputs cannot be treated as authentic folklore.

name: Wikimedia / Wikipedia REST API
rate_limit_info: Up to 200 requests/sec with polite custom User-Agent header.
supported_research_purpose: Entity summaries, documented folklore variants, alternate names, cultural classifications, and bibliographic references.
licensing_info: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA 4.0 / 3.0); requires proper attribution.
known_limitations: Secondary encyclopedic synthesis; presence on Wikipedia does not imply historical veracity or supernatural reality.

name: Wikidata SPARQL Query Service
rate_limit_info: Max 60-second query execution timeout; limit concurrent requests to 5; descriptive User-Agent required.
supported_research_purpose: Structured entity linking (Q-identifiers), geographic coordinates, cross-lingual labels, and thematic ontologies.
licensing_info: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication).
known_limitations: Queries must be strictly constrained to prevent timeouts; crowdsourced knowledge graph requires validation against source records.

name: Library of Congress JSON/YAML API
rate_limit_info: Standard polite throttling (10-20 requests/second); no API key required for public endpoint.
supported_research_purpose: American folklore collections, oral histories (American Folklife Center), historical newspaper accounts (Chronicling America).
licensing_info: Catalog metadata is dedicated to the public domain (CC0); digital items vary according to collection copyright.
known_limitations: Item-level rights must be checked individually; full text is not universally available or rights-cleared.

name: Internet Archive API & Metadata Service
rate_limit_info: Polite rate-limiting; HTTP 429 backoff required on burst queries.
supported_research_purpose: Digitized public domain folklore anthologies, 19th-century myth collections, and historical provenance tracking.
licensing_info: Item-specific rights; metadata is open; texts must be individually confirmed as pre-1929 public domain works.
known_limitations: Hosting on archive.org does not imply public domain status; scans frequently contain modern editorial or copyright restrictions.

name: Myths of Ireland Structured Dataset
rate_limit_info: Static file download; no operational query limits.
supported_research_purpose: Structured index of Irish mythological beings, places, stories, narrative cycles, and relationships.
licensing_info: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) for the downloadable index dataset.
known_limitations: Ireland-specific coverage only; provides an entity and story index, not full-length narrative text retellings.

name: Nichibunken Yōkai Database
rate_limit_info: Web search query limits; automated bulk harvesting prohibited.
supported_research_purpose: Scholarly research on Japanese yōkai folklore, supernatural phenomena, historical folklore literature, and citations.
licensing_info: Institutional copyright held by International Research Center for Japanese Studies (Nichibunken).
known_limitations: No public REST API; Japanese primary documentation; intended for bibliographic citation and scholarly reference.

name: Japan Search (NDL Cultural Heritage Platform)
rate_limit_info: Public REST and SPARQL endpoints; API keys available for high-throughput clients.
supported_research_purpose: Japanese cultural heritage records, digitized emakimono, folklore museum artifacts, and regional folklore archives.
licensing_info: Platform metadata provided under open data terms (CC0 / Government terms); linked media rights vary by holding institution.
known_limitations: High-quality metadata and ontology links, but rights for full media items depend on individual participating institutions.

name: Europeana Digital Heritage REST API
rate_limit_info: Requires free registered API key; default quota of 5 requests/sec.
supported_research_purpose: European folklore manuscripts, historical prints, folklore collection records across Greece, Germany, Ireland, and the UK.
licensing_info: Metadata is licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal; digital objects carry distinct rights statements (Public Domain, In Copyright, CC).
known_limitations: Requires external API key; returns cultural heritage object metadata and digitized scans rather than plain transcribed narratives.

name: National Cultural Audiovisual Archives (NCAA) — India
rate_limit_info: No public automated access; interactive public institutional portal.
supported_research_purpose: Indian intangible cultural heritage, oral traditions, regional narrative performances, and tribal folklore.
licensing_info: Ministry of Culture, Government of India; institutional repository rights reserved.
known_limitations: No documented REST API for programmatic ingestion; reference citations and catalogue metadata only.

name: Dúchas — National Folklore Collection of Ireland
rate_limit_info: Subject to Gaois research infrastructure usage terms.
supported_research_purpose: The Schools' Collection (Bailiúchán na Scol, 1937–1938), photographic folklore records, and folk tradition manuscripts.
licensing_info: Non-commercial educational and research reuse; commercial use requires permission; CC BY-NC 4.0 on specific datasets.
known_limitations: Legacy v0.6 API status must be tested before integration; NC license restricts general downstream redistribution.

name: Centro Nacional de Folclore e Cultura Popular (CNFCP / IPHAN) — Brazil
rate_limit_info: Web search portal; no bulk automated harvesting.
supported_research_purpose: Brazilian folklore, cordel literature, indigenous and Afro-Brazilian cultural traditions and bibliographic records.
licensing_info: IPHAN / CNFCP institutional copyright; public catalogue citations permitted.
known_limitations: No documented REST API; Portuguese search interface; catalogue and reference citation use only.

name: Project Gutenberg
rate_limit_info: Automated access strictly regulated; minimum 2-second delay between requests; bulk harvesting must use official mirror/feeds.
supported_research_purpose: Verified pre-1929 folklore anthologies (e.g. Joseph Jacobs, Andrew Lang, Brothers Grimm, Lafcadio Hearn).
licensing_info: Public Domain in the United States; Project Gutenberg trademark license applies to unmodified redistribution.
known_limitations: Robot access policy strictly enforced; texts must be validated for copyright expiration in user jurisdiction; Project Gutenberg header must be stripped if reused.

name: Urban Legends Archive
rate_limit_info: Standard web browsing; automated scraping prohibited.
supported_research_purpose: Discovery reference for curated modern urban legends, supernatural encounters, and motif classification.
licensing_info: Modern editorial narratives are proprietary; underlying traditional folk motifs are public domain.
known_limitations: No public API; text redistribution not permitted without express permission.

name: Business Insider World Urban Legends Survey
rate_limit_info: Standard web viewing under media publication terms.
supported_research_purpose: Secondary journalistic cross-reference highlighting prominent international urban legends across target nations.
licensing_info: Copyright Axel Springer / Business Insider; reference and citation only.
known_limitations: Journalistic overview; full-text redistribution strictly prohibited.

name: Wikipedia Category: Urban legends by country
rate_limit_info: Up to 200 requests/sec with polite custom User-Agent header.
supported_research_purpose: Systematic category traversal of documented urban legends organized by country across the 15 target nations.
licensing_info: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA 4.0 / 3.0); requires proper attribution.
known_limitations: Uneven geographic density across non-Western regions; requires editorial filtering for folklore vs modern viral hoaxes.
